== 说明 ==
要使用此模板，请添加{{T|{{BASEPAGENAME}}}}模板并填写对应字段。留空的字段不会在文章中显示。本信息框模板使用[[w:Help:Infobox|Fandom的信息框语法]]。

== 语法 ==
<pre>
{{Quest
 | title         = 
 | image         = [例如 "Example.jpg"]
 | imagecaption  = 
 | start         = 
 | end           = 
 | prerequisites = 
 | level         = 
 | location      = 
 | rewards       = 
 | previous      =
 | next          =
}}
</pre>

== 示例效果 ==
{{Quest
 | title         = 示例信息框
 | image         = Example.jpg
 | start         = Chrys
 | end           = Geran
 | prerequisites = 无
 | level         = 5
 | location      = 地球
 | rewards       = Justice-Wrought Petals
 | previous      = A
 | next          = C
}}
